findings.detail: positive_route_event checks the complete private Mihomo TCP line against the selected node, but exports only private_raw_line_sha256, source/target/rule/action fields and booleans. run_instance returns stdout/stderr hashes and sizes; execute then removes the 0600 private directory on a clean run. A postrun peer has neither the raw line nor a credential-free complete witness from which to recompute the decisive /32 PROXY action, selected-node match, or raw-line hash. The 26/26 synthetic fixtures prove the parser's fixture behavior, not the real binary's positive route line. EVO48 round-trip evidence gate is unmet.

parse_ssh_proof requires a pinned host-key debug line, publickey authentication debug line and numeric remote UID, but only stdout/stderr hashes and a derived proof are retained. Raw SSH streams are discarded with the private process context. A postrun peer cannot independently reconstruct the host-key/authentication transcript from hashes alone.

The candidate binds exact v2a/v2b receipts, candidate/runner/peer/release hashes, fresh START/TERMINAL one-shot gate, exact local ssh/nc binaries, one ED25519 known_hosts alias and fingerprint, /dev/null SSH config, fixed SOCKS loopback ProxyCommand, publickey BatchMode, remote LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/id -u only, and no HK01/graph/device/container/namespace/global proxy write path. main catches Exception, not SystemExit, so the v2b false rc2 path is addressed in code and fixtures. These are code-level observations, not a real-route or SSH result.

Candidate records root_release_present=false, start_present=false, terminal_present=false and positive_route_real_binary_observed=false. This NO_GO peer decision cannot satisfy runner.exact_release, which explicitly requires GO_V2C_V1_CODE_ONLY.

next_small_step: Freeze a new generation that retains a credential-free, independently recomputable witness for the real positive route and host-key/publickey/UID proof before private logs are deleted. Use a strict whitelist/redaction contract and a postrun negative fixture showing an altered route/action cannot pass. Re-review code and only then consider a new root one-shot release; do not replay this candidate or its nonce.
